<insights>
- Sabrina Carpenter starred as Maya Hart in the Disney Channel series Girl Meets World.
- Warmer in the Winter is the fourth studio album by violinist and composer Lindsey Stirling, released on October 20, 2017.
- Herbie Hancock had a role in Summer Holiday (1963 film).
</insights>

<answer>
Herbie Hancock was on the show "Summer Holiday" in 1963.
</answer>

<subanswer>
- The show where Maya Hart was played by an actress who was also in Warmer in the Winter is "Girl Meets World".
- The year Herbie Hancock was on "Summer Holiday" is 1963.
</subanswer>
